label: b25: laddertop, seed 4 of 8, 200M -- wave 1 of 1
notes: Batch b25, the champion attempt the b23 reading asked for: the ladder's top rung -- gamma 0.999, lambda 0.99, T 512, mse value loss, clip 0.2 -> 0.001 reached at 80% of the cap and held -- unchanged from b23e-h, at 8 seeds and 200M (4x the sweep's cap), head to head with b24. Why this and not another stacked lever: it is the most stable dense cell measured (64.4% density, 0.0% of evals below 50 on three of four seeds, 78 rows at >=99 /30k in one 4-seed wave), and adding an unmeasured knob on top is the b4 stacking failure. The 4x cap stretches the clip ramp 4x (0.15 at 50M, the clip b17cl's 99.5 checkpoint was saved under), so the anneal itself is the change under test. Prediction: later onset than b24 (T 512 banks 65,536 transitions per update), fewer evals below 80 across the whole run, density >= 60% from 50M on, and a >=99.3 /30k checkpoint on at least one seed; the record (99.65) needs a peak the 50M cells never reached, and the extra 150M at a clip that is still open is where it would come from. Read against b23's g999roll512msehold at 50M.
